description: Issue #286: a local query retains runtime errors after it drops private ranked conditions.
grammar:
%rule text r "b"
%rule r ("a" ≻ $x:"a" long) [+T]
%conditions $x = "x"
%rule long "b"
%conditions $.value.split("" ++ "")
%check local #·_<_Elided> %conditions $.preceding-element.local-readings.ending-after($) %warning "bad"
